about_the_game:
Commerce And Stealthy Heists (C.A.S.H.) drops you into a dual life of respectability and risk. Sunshine hours are for buying stock, setting prices, and charming customers. When darkness falls, the real profits begin: scout empty apartments, disable alarms, and lift valuables before the cops catch on—all with friends in four-player online co-op.

Key Features:

Daytime Retail Tycoon

Order goods from competing suppliers, refurbish second-hand finds, and react to a dynamic economy.

Customize shelving, décor, and signage to attract bigger crowds and VIP buyers.

Night-Time Stealth Heists

Purchase intel, pick locks, cut wires, and outsmart traps in procedural apartments.

Mini-games for lock-picking, circuit hacking, and trap disarming keep every break-in tense.

Three Skill Trees

Commerce

Stealth

Tech

Co-op Roles

Reputation & Risk

Clean sales grow your public image; dodgy goods raise suspicion and police patrols.

A rising Heat meter unlocks tougher security systems—and bigger payouts.

Side Hustles

Take courier jobs, flip rare collectors’ items, or dabble in the black market to fund new gear.

content_descriptors.notes: Our game contains scenes of animal killing and butchering, as well as PvP (player versus player) combat with violent elements. Players can engage in combat encounters using rifles, leading to bloody and gory scenes. The game also features scenes of butchering killed animals to gather resources. This content may be disturbing to some players, especially those sensitive to violent scenes.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX 11
  • VR Support: No
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700 / AMD FX-8320
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 / AMD Radeon R9 290
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection

  • Sound Card: DirectX 12
